hint: This is the guided tour, so there's no mission to finish. Click the ship symbol at the bottom of the screen to pick a guide. You'll be taken straight to them.
You're on the guided tour, so just wander and enjoy the ship. Whenever you like, click the ship symbol below to choose another guide. Remember that a tour can't be saved.

You're in your London flat. Look around and click the things that hold memories: papers, pictures, cards, the cabinet and the mantle. You can switch on the radio too. Keep exploring and something will happen.
Look around your flat and examine the things in it. The memories they hold will move the story along.
Someone is knocking. Open your cabin door and see who it is.
Before you go, pick up your personal things. Your bag is on the bed and your watch is on the dresser. Both will come in handy.
Smethells says your belongings are still in cabin C-73. Go back and pick up your bag and watch.
You're in the right place. The note's author is waiting by the electric camel. Talk to her and hear her out until she's told you everything, including where to find her later.
The gymnasium is up here on the boat deck, on the starboard side. Enter through the vestibule and it's right beside you.
Your note was signed P.P. and mentioned the electric camel. That's in the gymnasium, on the starboard side of the boat deck. Take the lift to A deck, then go up the Grand Staircase.
This is the cryptograph Penny told you about. Work through Zeitel's telegram on it slowly and carefully. One slip spoils the result.
You have Zeitel's telegram, but it's in code. Open your trunk with the key from your bag. The cryptograph inside will unscramble it.
You've got Zeitel's telegram! It's in code, so take it back to cabin C-73. The cryptograph in your trunk will decode it.
Trask had a feeling about where this pipe had been. You're in the Turkish bath; look around closely and try things out.

That pipe from the café may hold a clue. Leyland Trask, the psychic, can 'read' objects; he's on the Grand Staircase. Or try the Turkish bath on its own: take the lift to D deck and go through the doors beneath the stairs.
You're in! Look through the telegrams by the operator's desk. Zeitel's messages are what you're after.
Officer Morrow has said you can look in the wireless room. It's on the port side of the boat deck, toward the bow. Go on in.
Officer Morrow guards the wireless room. He won't bend the rules for a stranger. Chat with him and show real interest in the man himself. A friend might get a peek inside.
Penny wants Zeitel's telegrams, so get into the wireless room on the port side of the boat deck, toward the bow. If you're stuck, Max Siedlemann knows Zeitel and haunts the decks.
The seaman said the needle on the power gauge has to sit in the green zone. If you're stuck, step back and ask him for advice. He has an instruction manual.
You fixed the seaman's panel. Speak to him again in the control room. He's grateful and may let you go further below.
The seaman here is having trouble with his control panel and won't let passengers past. Talk to him. Maybe you can solve his problem.
You're on F deck in second class, near Penny's cabin. The way down to the turbine room starts somewhere along this corridor.
The drop is in the boiler rooms! Penny says the lift attendant knows the ship. Take the second-class stairs (aft) down to F deck and look for a way further below.
Vlad has his package and has gone. Now collect the Rubaiyat from the Purser's safe. His office is on C deck by the forward Grand Staircase.
You have the Rubaiyat! Others below decks are after it, so think about who sees it and where it would be safe.
You have Vlad's package from cabin A-14. Take it down to him in the boiler rooms; he said he'd wait there.
You're among the A deck cabins. Knock on A-14 and tell Mr. Barbicon you've come from Vlad.
Vlad asked you to fetch a package from his friend Mr. Barbicon in cabin A-14. Take the lift to A deck; the cabins are straight ahead.
The stowaway in the boiler room is still hoping for help. Hear him out; doing him a favour may tell you who he's working with.
You're in the boiler rooms. Search them carefully; something was hidden down here. Someone else is lurking, too, so talk to him.
The boiler rooms are just off the engine room. Find the door and go through.

The seaman will let you through now. Go down to the control room below the turbine room (via F deck, second class), then through the engine room into the boiler rooms. Get to the Rubaiyat before it changes hands.
Penny wants to see the Rubaiyat herself. Collect it from the Purser on C deck, then take it to her in cabin F-34.
You have the Rubaiyat. Report to Penny in F-34 (F deck, second class) and tell her everything you've learned.
That photograph could be the evidence Penny wants. Show it to her in cabin F-34 and tell her what you've found.
Burns's cabin doubles as his darkroom. Have a look at his pictures and see what you can develop. Darkrooms and bright lights don't mix.
Burns has gone off to find his wife and left his cabin, C-78, open. It's on the port side of C deck. Slip in and look at his photographs.
Keep an eye out on this staircase for a lady in a blue hat. That might be Burns's wife. Then go back and tell him, and be kind about it.
Burns won't show his work while he's upset about his wife, Stephanie, in a blue hat. Look for her nearby on the C deck Grand Staircase. Then go back and talk to him kindly.
A photographer, Mr. Burns, may have a picture of Zeitel with his contact. He's in cabin C-78, on the port side of C deck. Knock on his door.
Nothing more for you down here. Report to Penny in F-34 on F deck, second class. She'll want to hear what happened.
Time to report. Knock on Penny's door, F-34. It's on F deck in second class; use the second-class stairs at the back of the ship.
This is the crate. Search it for the painting.
You're in the cargo hold. Find the Carters' motor car and the crate near it. It's pitch dark in there, so look for a way to light the place up. Hurry: Zeitel's after the painting too.
With the Carters' car keys you can get past the seaman guarding the cargo hold. Go to the forecastle at the bow, then head down toward the cargo room.
The Purser has gone to deliver the cufflink, so his office off this landing is empty. Look around it for the Carters' car keys.
The Purser hurried off to deliver Mr. Straus's cufflink. While he's gone, visit his office on C deck by the forward Grand Staircase and look for the car keys.
You found Mr. Straus's gold cufflink! Take it back to the Purser on C deck.
The Strausses were sitting here in the Reception Room earlier, at the foot of the stairs. Search the chairs for the lost cufflink.
Mr. Straus has lost a gold cufflink. People saw the Strausses in the first-class Reception Room on D deck, so search there. The lift goes straight down to it.
The cargo seaman only lets through someone with the Carters' car keys, and the Carters leave theirs with the Purser. Go back to the Purser and see how you can help him.
A seaman guards the cargo hold and won't let passengers in. Only someone with the right car keys gets through, so you'll need to find those first.

The manifest says the painting's crate is in the cargo hold beneath the forecastle, at the bow. Get to the forecastle (the lift attendant can direct you) and find the way down through the crew's quarters.
The Purser has stepped out to see the Thayers. This is your chance to peek at his cargo manifest. Go to his office on C deck by the forward Grand Staircase.
Mr. Thayer's telegram is sent. Go and tell the Purser on C deck.
You're in the wireless room. Use the equipment here to send the Purser's telegram for Mr. Thayer.
You offered to send Mr. Thayer's telegram for the Purser. Take it to the wireless room on the port side of the boat deck, toward the bow.
The Purser's office is right here, off the C deck landing. He's frazzled tonight. Ask what's troubling him and offer a hand. A grateful Purser is a helpful one.
Penny wants the painting Zeitel's after. There must be a record of it coming aboard, so try the Purser. His office is on C deck by the forward Grand Staircase.
After your match, Smethells has a message for you from Haderlitz. Look for him in the D deck Reception Room, or ring the bell in your cabin.
Haderlitz is waiting for you here. Talk to him and take up his challenge. Even if you lose, play at least one match.
Haderlitz wants to meet you on the squash court. Take the lift to D deck and walk through the D deck cabins. The door down to the court is near the end of the corridor.
Smethells has been looking for you. Ring the bell by your cabin door to call him.
Penny says Smethells was looking for you. Find him: ring the bell in cabin C-73, or check the C deck Grand Staircase.
You're among the D deck cabins. Knock on D-19 and show the young lady the ring.
Trask says there's a pretty girl Haderlitz knows who will help if she sees the ring. Ask around about Willie's sweetheart; the lift attendant and Max both seem to know her.
Leyland Trask holds court on the Grand Staircase by the carved clock. He reads personal objects; let him see Haderlitz's ring.
Haderlitz gave you his ring. Penny suggests Leyland Trask might know more about it. He waits on the Grand Staircase by the clock carving, 'where Honor and Glory crown Time'.
Penny will want to see the painting. Collect it from the Purser on C deck, then take it to her in F-34.
Penny's cabin, F-34, is right here. Knock. She's been asking for you urgently.
Everyone says Miss Pringle wants you urgently. Go to her cabin, F-34, on F deck in second class. Use the second-class stairs at the back of the ship.
Trask said these cigarettes belong to Mr. Siedlemann, and Max is here in the smoking room. Show them to him and see what he remembers.
Whose Old Reds are these? Max Siedlemann smokes nothing else, and tonight he's in the smoking room. Take the lift to A deck, go aft to the aft Grand Staircase and enter the smoking room.
'A Garden by the Water': the Café Parisien fits. Look closely around the tables.
'The Vine her ancient Ruby... a Garden by the Water.' Where on board is full of greenery? If you're puzzled, Trask loves a riddle.
This is Scotland Road. The verse spoke of 'many knots unraveled by the Road'. Look closely at what's along this stretch.

The verse Haderlitz left mentions knots and 'the Road'. Trask can help you read it. The long E deck passage the crew call Scotland Road is worth a look; take the lift to D deck and go down the stairs beneath it.
This is a grim sight, but look closely at Haderlitz and the things around him. He may have left something behind.
The electric bath is further in, past the steam room. Go through and see what's happened.
Penny heard something has happened at the Turkish bath. Take the lift to D deck, go through the doors beneath the stairs and walk down. Smethells is at the bath.
Same trouble as before: get the gauge needle into the green zone. If you need a refresher, ask the seaman for his manual.
The seaman will let you into the engine room again. Go on through. The way into the smokestack starts there, so keep your wits about you.
Your old friend the seaman is having engine trouble again and won't let anyone past. Talk to him and offer your clever hands once more.

Max saw Haderlitz hiding something at the top of the last smokestack, and Penny says the only way in is through the engine room. Go down past F deck second class and the turbine room to the control room.
You've reached the top of the smokestack. Look around carefully for whatever Haderlitz hid up here.
Keep climbing. The ladders twist about inside the funnel, so if you reach a dead end, go back and try another way up.
Somewhere in the engine room is the crew's way up into the smokestack. Explore it fully to find the access.
Haderlitz hid something at the top of the last smokestack. Go back to the engine room (through the control room, below the turbine room) and climb up inside.
Zeitel won't stop you now. Make your way back down the smokestack and out into the engine room with the notebook.
You're cornered at the top of the smokestack. Think hard before you hand anything over. Penny gave you something for protection, in case you needed it.
Get out of the smokestack. Climb back down to the engine room.
Steady hands. Study how the device is put together before you touch anything, and work methodically. There may be a way to get it open safely.
Zeitel has locked you in, and he mentioned a bomb on the sofa. Go and look at it; that's your only way out.
Zeitel left the notebook here as 'bedside reading'. Don't leave C-59 without it.
Someone's knocking urgently at your cabin door. Answer it.
Shailagh is waiting on these stairs for her baby. Give him back to his mother.
You've got the baby! Take him back to Shailagh on the second-class staircase, at the C deck level. There's still time to get them both to the boats.
Mrs. Conkling is somewhere on this deck with the baby, trying to get into a boat. Find her and see whether she'll trade, as Shailagh hoped.
Shailagh begged you to find Mrs. Conkling, who is heading for the lifeboats with the baby, and see if she'll trade for the letter. Go up to the boat deck.
Lady Georgia is in Sasha's cabin, A-14, right here. Knock and get the antidote to her quickly.
You have the antidote. Zeitel said Lady Georgia is in Sasha's cabin, A-14, on A deck. Hurry!
Zeitel is waiting in the first-class lounge with the antidote, and he wants the painting. Lady Georgia's life hangs on it. Remember that a painting can sometimes be won back later.
Vlad wants to slip into a lifeboat unnoticed, and it's women and children first. Perhaps something you carry could help him. Bargain for what you need.
Penny thinks Haderlitz gave the painting to a friend. Who did he trust below decks? Steerage passengers are gathering on the second-class staircase around C deck.
Zeitel has the painting, and what he wants most now is a way off the ship. Find him on the boat deck; your boat pass might buy it back.
Zeitel has the painting. Penny thinks you could trade him for it. He'll want a way off the ship. Buick Riviera in the smoking room has something everyone wants tonight.

Penny suspects Vlad has the Rubaiyat. He's hiding below in the turbine room, F deck second class. He'll want help getting into a lifeboat unnoticed. Claris, near the first-class lounge on A deck, may have something useful.

Penny believes Vlad has the notebook. He's below in the turbine room, F deck second class. He wants to reach a lifeboat unnoticed. Something from Claris, by the first-class lounge on A deck, might help.
Penny thinks Zeitel hid the notebook in his cabin, C-59, on the starboard side of C deck. Go and look, but be careful.
Vlad has Lord Lambeth's real necklace. That shouldn't leave with him. Find him in the turbine room below and strike a bargain to help him reach the boats.

when: global:mission=4 & prop:painting=frank & prop:notebook=frank & prop:rubaiyat=frank & prop:realneck!=vlad & prop:boatpass=frank & global:phase<3
hint: You've got all the evidence and a boat pass. Go to the boat deck and show the pass to a seaman who is loading the lifeboats.

when: global:mission=4 & prop:painting=frank & prop:notebook=frank & prop:rubaiyat=frank & prop:realneck!=vlad & global:phase=4
hint: The seamen's boats are nearly gone. Stay close to Officer Morrow at the last lifeboats. If you've kept calm and been of use to him, he may find room for you.

when: global:mission=4 & prop:painting=frank & prop:notebook=frank & prop:rubaiyat=frank & prop:realneck!=vlad & prop:boatpass=buick
hint: Now you need a way off. Buick Riviera, at the blackjack table in the smoking room, has a lifeboat pass. He plays for real stakes, so bring something valuable. Or wait near Officer Morrow until the last boats.
You have everything Penny wanted. Now get off the ship: head to the boat deck and find a lifeboat that will take you.
Time is almost up and the last boats are leaving. Get to the boat deck now and find Officer Morrow at the final lifeboat. Whatever you haven't recovered, your life matters more.
You still need the Rubaiyat before the ship goes down. Think about who wanted it below decks, and where you last saw him.
The Titanic is sinking. Gather the Rubaiyat, the painting and the notebook, and get them off the ship. The lifts are shut down, so use the stairs. Penny is up on the boat deck.
Not sure what to do? Ring for Smethells with the bell in your cabin, C-73, or visit Penny in F-34. The lift attendant by the Grand Staircase can direct you anywhere on the ship.
